title: Accessing Längle's 4FMs Through Guided Meditation — 2FM: Do I like being alive? (Life)
description: A guided meditation on the second of Alfried Längle's Four Fundamental Motivations (4FMs) — Life: Do I like being alive? — translating its three existential prerequisites (Relationship, Time, and Closeness) into guided imagery. Includes the audio recording, full transcript (PDF/TXT), captions (VTT) and word-level timings (CSV). Companion to the WCET4 (2026) workshop by Graham Nelson-Zutter. This version adds the scored text: the caption cue text stripped of its header, notes, cue numbers and timings, which is the exact text scored in the ISEA Journal study.
